Multiple_trials_note: Two trial sequences: first trial April 28-May 1, 2008 (4 days) on original source jurisdiction/meat certificates issue, concluded with jury verdict on 5/1/2008; second trial March 9-18, 2009 (7 days) on hide export certificates claims, concluded with jury verdict on 3/18/2009. The second trial is the final completed trial sequence used for all date and day-count fields. Note: the April 2008 trial resulted in a verdict on the original source/meat claims; the March 2009 trial resulted in a verdict on the hide claims. Final judgment entered in favor of Relator on 5 of 1000+ claims ($27,822.50) and in favor of Defendants on remaining claims; on remand, judgment ultimately entered in favor of Defendants on hide claims as well.
Delib_schedule: Day 1: 2:54 PM to 4:50 PM, 116 min; Day 2: 4:50 PM to 4:56 PM, 6 min; Day 3: 9:00 AM to 3:54 PM, 414 min; Day 4: 9:00 AM to 3:54 PM, 414 min
Verdict_note: Special verdict form for March 2009 Hides Trial. Jury found defendants made major or significant changes to hide export certificates (Q1: YES). Found 5 certificates with major/significant changes where no replacement certificate was obtained (Q2). Found 5 certificates were changed knowingly (Q3). Found 0 certificates were changed with intent to conceal/avoid/decrease obligation (Q4). No monetary damages were awarded on this form; the form addresses liability findings only.
